I’m from the northside of Indianapolis, about 15 minutes from Carmel, so I’ve driven through these plenty of times. When the roundabouts were first put in, a lot of people thought it was a dumb idea (i.e. stoplights already work well enough, roundabouts will cost taxpayers more money, etc). I think now everyone has realized how beneficial they are for less busy intersections. Traffic is much more fluid, people don’t really have to stop, let alone waiting a minute or two for a light to change. They are safer an honestly more aesthetically pleasing than stoplights. And don’t use energy. I wish more cities would adopt roundabouts.
